snippet.title: DOOM: The Dark Ages | Official Trailer 2 (4K) | Available May 15, 2025
snippet.description:
Enjoy Official Trailer #2 for DOOM: The Dark Ages 

Developed by id Software, DOOM: The Dark Ages is the prequel to the critically acclaimed DOOM (2016) and DOOM Eternal that tells an epic cinematic story worthy of the DOOM Slayer’s legend. In this third installment of the modern DOOM series, players will step into the blood-stained boots of the DOOM Slayer, in this never-before-seen dark and sinister medieval war against Hell.  

Coming May 15, 2025. Pre-order on Xbox Series X|S, PC or PlayStation 5. https://t.co/DCP5jMAfk4 


For more information on all things DOOM: The Dark Ages and id Software, follow these channels and join the Slayers Club.   

Twitter: https://x.com/DOOM/ 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/doom/  
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/doom.com 
Threads: https://www.threads.net/@doom 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/DOOM 
Website: https://doom.bethesda.net/ 
Slayers Club: https://slayersclub.bethesda.net/ 


ESRB RATING: Mature for Blood and Gore and Intense Violence.
